<thought>Based on the mass spectrum ([M+H]+ = 276.0666) the neutral mass is ~275.059 Da. The 13 C NMR shows 13 distinct carbon signals: one carbonyl (~166 ppm), nine aromatic carbons (115‑151 ppm), one O‑CH₂ (~61 ppm) and one methyl (~14 ppm). This suggests a molecule with 13 carbons, but one carbon may be symmetry‑equivalent, giving 13 observed signals for 14 actual carbons. A plausible molecular formula that matches the exact mass is C₁₄H₁₂O₆ (exact mass = 276.0634 Da, [M+H]+ = 276.0706 Da, within a few mDa of the observed ion). I will request possible isomers for this formula to identify the correct structure and obtain its SMILES.</thought>
